_about: A blind reader's verdict on each agreement example a card shows (fil.adjectives.explanation); only approved examples ship.

لَوْنٌ مُتَشابِهٌ.note: مُتَشابِه is reciprocal ('resembling one another'); a single لَوْن مُتَشابِه / 'similar color' with no comparand is unnatural in Arabic, English and Bosnian.

اللَّوْنُ الْمُتَشابِهُ.note: مُتَشابِه is reciprocal ('resembling one another'); a single لَوْن مُتَشابِه / 'similar color' with no comparand is unnatural in Arabic, English and Bosnian.

ثَمَرَةٌ مُتَشابِهَةٌ.note: Singular ثَمَرَة مُتَشابِهَة unnatural (مُتَشابِه needs plurality/comparand); 'a similar fruit' / 'sličan plod' dangle.

اللَّوْنُ مُتَشابِهٌ.note: مُتَشابِه is reciprocal ('resembling one another'); a single لَوْن مُتَشابِه / 'similar color' with no comparand is unnatural in Arabic, English and Bosnian.

السَّاحِرُ كَذَّابٌ.note: 'The magician is lying.' means he is telling a lie now; كَذّاب / 'lažljiv' = is a liar — use 'The magician is a liar.'

الْبَيْتُ آخَرُ.note: Meaningless predicate: "The house is other." / "Kuća je druga." is unnatural in English and Bosnian (and الْبَيْتُ آخَرُ is odd Arabic); آخَر is not a natural predicate adjective - drop this example.

الرَّجُلُ خَبِيرٌ.note: English "The man is expert." is ungrammatical; needs "The man is an expert." (Arabic and Bosnian fine).

الْبَيْتُ قَرِيبٌ.note: Bosnian "Kuća je obližnja." is unnatural as a predicate; use "Kuća je blizu."

الطَّائِرُ حَيٌّ.note: English "The bird is living." is unnatural; use "The bird is alive." (Arabic and Bosnian fine).

ساعَةٌ مَعْلُومَةٌ.note: English "a known hour" is unnatural and does not match Bosnian "određeni sat"; meaning here is fixed/appointed: "a fixed (set) hour".

أَيَّامٌ مَعْلُومَةٌ.note: English "known days" does not match Bosnian "određeni dani" and is unidiomatic; use "fixed/set days". Also close to the Quranic phrase أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ (22:28) - consider another noun.

مَدِينَةٌ قَصِيَّةٌ.note: Correct feminine agreement, indefinite nominative; 'udaljen grad' correctly uses the short form for the masculine Bosnian noun.
